description.value: Cedar Hill Recreation Centre is a large municipal multi-sport and arts complex operated by the District of Saanich, offering indoor tennis and squash courts, a gymnasium, weight room, and a fully equipped arts centre with ceramics, dance, and visual arts studios. The facility also hosts an art gallery and café with seating, making it a genuine community hub rather than a single-sport venue. Touring cyclists visiting the Saanich area will find a substantial public facility with a range of drop-in programming and free vehicle parking on site.
